Module is intended for the control of speed of the turbo set within its 
 complete working range.

The speed control module Sc 2.3 (A12) 
function to control the speed of turbo set within its complete working range:
 - Turning speed equal 70 RPM,
 - Heating speed equal 1200 RPM,
 - Phasing speed equal 3000 RPM.

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, tested by
 eng.

eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head Sector of Talkha Power Station

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
Module is intended for the control of speed of the turbo set within its 
 complete working range.
The speed control module Sc 2.3 (A12) 
function to control the speed of turbo set within its complete working range:
 - Turning speed equal 70 RPM,
 - Heating speed equal 1200 RPM,
 - Phasing speed equal 3000 RPM.
This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The first draft 
initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, tested by
 eng. 
Ashraf Farid at 20 May 2003, revised by quality control EDEPCo. eng. Abdl Menem Al-Emam, accepted by general director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by 
eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head Sector of Talkha Power Station
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should be carry the 
suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area, 
is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Unit out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Digital 
 Multimeter type Fluke 85
Voltage 
 Injection set type Siemens Calibrator O5 7NH2011
Screw driver
Work to be Carried Out
Connect jumper between point X20:90 and point 
 X20:110 in rear control cabinet side no. JC02 (Imitation condition : 
 limiter > limit)
Disconnect point X20:108
 in rear control cabinet side NO: JC02 
 (Imitation condition: tripe oil ok)
Disconnect socket A31+54
 type A2121B1 in front control cabinet side 
 no. JC03 
 (Imitation condition: Digital speed)
Inject voltage equal desired speed according 
 to the attached curve on socket A31+54 type A2121B1(Point 8 and 7) in front 
 control cabinet side no. JC03 check the turbine speed ok at digital 
 speed indicator in control room. (see table 1, and chart)
Measure voltage on points A12+40:3 type 
 A2110B1, A12+52:7 type A2703b
 in front control cabinet side no. JC01 
 to see that module cards tracing this inject voltage.
If any measuring point not tracing (according 
 the circuit diagram) then change the bad Card.
Set push bottom (Hand / Automatic) on desired 
 speed to automatic on control panel. figure 1
Continue with increase injection volt slowly 
 with observation departure and correct value must be zero when value actually 
 of speed equal desired of speed the lamp of push Bottom H/A on
 desired 
 speed will be light and system change to hand mode automatically.
